topics.title: Meaning and nature of financial statements

concepts.learning_objective: State what financial statements are and which statements they include.
Explain how recorded facts, conventions, postulates and personal judgements shape financial statements.
Explain that the primary objective of financial statements is to assist users in decision-making.
Identify the specific objectives of financial statements and match them to users' needs.

topics.title: Form of balance sheet and shareholders' funds under Schedule III

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the heads, sub-heads and presentation features of the balance sheet under Schedule III.
Show share capital, calls-in-arrears and forfeited shares in the balance sheet and notes to accounts.
Compute and present reserves and surplus, including a debit balance of the statement of profit and loss.

topics.title: Current and non-current classification of balance sheet items

concepts.learning_objective: State the criteria for classifying an item as current or non-current.
Classify borrowings, trade payables, provisions and deferred tax under the correct heads.
Classify fixed assets, investments, inventories and trade receivables under the correct heads.

topics.title: Form and content of the statement of profit and loss

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish revenue from operations from other income.
Place expenses under the correct heads of the statement of profit and loss.
Compute profit before tax in the Schedule III format.

topics.title: Uses and importance of financial statements

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how different users rely on financial statements for their decisions.
Explain limitations arising from historical cost and the realisable value of assets.
Explain limitations of bias, aggregation, missing and qualitative information, and interim reporting.
